, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the father as Prince Bernhard of Lippe-Biesterfeld (the maternal grandfather) instead of Pieter van Vollenhoven, despite prior sources confirming Pieter as the father. This confusion (likely due to the shared name “Bernhard”) contradicted the evidence and could have led to the wrong birth date.
